## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (format, analyze, l10n, tests, coverage)
- [ ] New or changed logic has unit tests; bug fixes include a test that failed before
- [ ] New UI follows the layout rules in AGENTS.md and is tested on a small phone, large text and tablet
- [ ] User-facing strings are in every ARB file
- [ ] No new `// ignore:` without a reason next to it
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
